```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)
library(janitor)
library(here)
library(haven)
library(tigris)
library(tidycensus)
library(purrr)
library(ipumsr)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)

library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(slider)
library(broom)

```


```{r Step 0: Pull in ANES Data, include=TRUE}
anes_panel <- read_dta(here("00_rawdata", "anes_timeseries_cdf_stata_20260205.dta"))
```

```{r Step 1: Cleaning Up the Dataset, include=TRUE}
# Check the variables
anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  rename(year = VCF0004, trust_gov_index = VCF0656, trust_gov = VCF0604)

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  rename(econ_views = VCF0870, stock_owns = VCF9224, social_class = VCF0149)

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  rename(person_finances = VCF0880, person_finances_scale = VCF0880a, personal_finances_next = VCF0881)

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  rename(age = VCF0101, age_group = VCF0102, gender = VCF0104, race = VCF0105a, educ = VCF0110, income_group = VCF0114, emp_status = VCF0116, homeowner = VCF0146, marital_stat = VCF0147, partisan_id = VCF0301, partisan_strength = VCF0305, pol_interest = VCF0310)

anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  rename(union_mem = VCF0127)

anes_panel %>%
  select(year, trust_gov_index, econ_views) %>%
  glimpse()

# Frequency distributions
table(anes_panel$trust_gov_index, useNA = "ifany")
table(anes_panel$econ_views, useNA = "ifany")

# Cross-tab by year
anes_panel %>%
  count(year, trust_gov_index, econ_views)

anes_analysis <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(econ_views),
    !is.na(trust_gov_index)
  )


```

```{r Step 2: Year-Specific Associations, include=TRUE}
year_models <- anes_analysis %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    mod <- lm(trust_gov_index ~ econ_views, data = .x)
    tidy(mod)
  }) %>%
  filter(term == "econ_views")

year_models


ggplot(year_models, aes(x = year, y = estimate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
      ymax = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
    ),
    width = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "ANES survey wave year",
    y = "Association between economic evaluation and trust",
    title = "The relationship between economic evaluations and trust in government over time",
    subtitle = "OLS coefficients for retrospective economic evaluation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
